other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding such amount as may be specified by the byelaw.

Note:
Section 64(2) of the Airports Act 1986 provides that the maximum fine that a byelaw may specify is an amount at level four on the standard scale or of a lower amount.

Time limit on prosecutions:
6 months
